name: _cufft_get_plan_cache_max_size
description: Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI): aten::_cufft_get_plan_cache_max_size(int device_index) -> int. Registered schema strings: aten::_cufft_get_plan_cache_max_size(int device_index) -> int. Semantics: returns the current cuFFT plan cache capacity of the given device as a Python int; it is a pure query that mutates no parameter, and the pytest re-reads the native capacity after the call to confirm it is unchanged. The capacity read back is configured by the separate aten::_cufft_set_plan_cache_max_size, while aten::_cufft_clear_plan_cache clears the plans and, per the pytest comment, clearing plans must not reset the capacity. Original Gems pytest calls and results define the full contract, including keyword invocation, int-like and low-byte-aliasing index spellings, the out-of-range and non-integer rejection errors, and wrong-arity behavior; do not narrow tests to this representative signature. This definition models only the representative overload; the index spellings are supplied by pytest (including a 0-dim integer tensor and non-integer values) and are not generated from these hints.
